race.comment: NEGATIVE NIBBS (2) turned in a fair 5th placed finish last time at this track over 350m (19.44). Ready to return to form. MOE SOUTH BANJO (1) recorded her 3rd career win last time at this track, scoring by 6 lengths (16.63). Was a winner at her only start from this draw. Expected to feature again. ROCKY RAY (8) hit the frame latest (16.82) when third at this track in a Grade 5. Has already won out of this draw. Can hit the frame with the right run. BRUREE LUCK (7) found the frame for the second consecutive time when narrowly beaten into second last time out (16.79) over 300m at this track.
